package postgres

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"

)

// CatalogScopeRepoPG implements CatalogScopeRepository.
type CatalogScopeRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r CatalogScopeRepoPG) ListPublic(ctx context.Context, lang string) ([]domain.CatalogScope, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
WITH requested_i18n AS (
    SELECT id FROM i18n WHERE language = $1
)
SELECT
    t.id,
    t.slug,
    COALESCE(t.source_key, ''),
    COALESCE(ti.title, ti_fallback.title, t.slug),
    t."order",
    cl.id,
    cl.slug,
    COALESCE(cl.source_key, ''),
    COALESCE(cli.title, cli_fallback.title, cl.slug),
    tl."order",
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)::int
FROM track t
JOIN track_level tl ON tl.track_id = t.id AND tl.status = $2
JOIN course_level cl ON cl.id = tl.level_id AND cl.status = $2
JOIN level_course_group lcg ON lcg.level_id = cl.id AND lcg.status = $2
JOIN course_group cg ON cg.id = lcg.group_id AND cg.status = $2
JOIN course_group_course cgc ON cgc.group_id = cg.id AND cgc.status = $2
JOIN course c ON c.id = cgc.course_id AND c.status = $3 AND c.catalog_visible = TRUE
LEFT JOIN requested_i18n ri ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN track_i18n ti ON ti.track_id = t.id AND ti.i18n_id = ri.id
LEFT JOIN course_level_i18n cli ON cli.level_id = cl.id AND cli.i18n_id = ri.id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT title FROM track_i18n WHERE track_id = t.id ORDER BY i18n_id LIMIT 1
) ti_fallback ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT title FROM course_level_i18n WHERE level_id = cl.id ORDER BY i18n_id LIMIT 1
) cli_fallback ON TRUE
WHERE t.status = $2
GROUP BY
    t.id, t.slug, t.source_key, ti.title, ti_fallback.title, t."order",
    cl.id, cl.slug, cl.source_key, cli.title, cli_fallback.title, tl."order"
ORDER BY
    t."order" ASC NULLS LAST,
    COALESCE(t.source_key, t.id::text) ASC,
    tl."order" ASC,
    COALESCE(cl.source_key, cl.id::text) ASC,
    t.id ASC,
    cl.id ASC`, lang, domain.CatalogStatusActive, domain.CourseStatusActive)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	result := []domain.CatalogScope{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var item domain.CatalogScope
		if err := rows.Scan(
			&item.TrackID,
			&item.TrackSlug,
			&item.TrackSourceKey,
			&item.TrackTitle,
			&item.TrackOrder,
			&item.LevelID,
			&item.LevelSlug,
			&item.LevelSourceKey,
			&item.LevelTitle,
			&item.LevelOrder,
			&item.CourseCount,
		); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

// TrackRepoPG implements TrackRepository.
type TrackRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r TrackRepoPG) Create(ctx context.Context, track domain.Track) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO track (id, slug, source_key, "order", status, lesson_read_access, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1,$2,NULLIF($3,''),$4,$5,$6,$7,$8)`,
		track.ID, track.Slug, track.SourceKey, track.Order, track.Status, track.LessonReadAccess, track.CreatedAt, track.UpdatedAt)
	return mapPgError(err)
}

func (r TrackRepoPG) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.Track, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, slug, COALESCE(source_key,''), "order", status, lesson_read_access, created_at, updated_at FROM track WHERE id=$1`, id)
	var item domain.Track
	if err := row.Scan(&item.ID, &item.Slug, &item.SourceKey, &item.Order, &item.Status, &item.LessonReadAccess, &item.CreatedAt, &item.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &item, nil
}

func (r TrackRepoPG) GetBySourceKey(ctx context.Context, sourceKey string) (*domain.Track, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, slug, COALESCE(source_key,''), "order", status, lesson_read_access, created_at, updated_at FROM track WHERE source_key=$1`, sourceKey)
	var item domain.Track
	if err := row.Scan(&item.ID, &item.Slug, &item.SourceKey, &item.Order, &item.Status, &item.LessonReadAccess, &item.CreatedAt, &item.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &item, nil
}

func (r TrackRepoPG) Update(ctx context.Context, track domain.Track) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE track SET slug=$1, "order"=$2, status=$3, lesson_read_access=$4, updated_at=now() WHERE id=$5`,
		track.Slug, track.Order, track.Status, track.LessonReadAccess, track.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return mapPgError(err)
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

func (r TrackRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE track SET status=$1, updated_at=now() WHERE id=$2`, domain.CatalogStatusNoActive, id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

func (r TrackRepoPG) List(ctx context.Context, filter filters.TrackFilters) ([]domain.Track, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	args := []any{}
	where := []string{}

	if filter.Title != nil {
		args = append(args, "%"+*filter.Title+"%")
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_i18n ti WHERE ti.track_id = t.id AND ti.title ILIKE $%d)", len(args)))
	}
	if filter.ID != nil {
		args = append(args, *filter.ID)
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("t.id = $%d", len(args)))
	}
	if filter.Slug != nil {
		args = append(args, *filter.Slug)
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("t.slug = $%d", len(args)))
	}
	if filter.Status != nil {
		args = append(args, *filter.Status)
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("t.status = $%d", len(args)))
	}
	if filter.ActiveOnly {
		args = append(args, domain.CatalogStatusActive)
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("t.status = $%d", len(args)))
	}

	query := `SELECT t.id, t.slug, COALESCE(t.source_key,''), t."order", t.status, t.lesson_read_access, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM track t`
	if len(where) > 0 {
		query += " WHERE " + strings.Join(where, " AND ")
	}
	query += ` ORDER BY t."order" ASC NULLS LAST, t.source_key ASC NULLS LAST, t.created_at ASC, t.id ASC`

	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	result := []domain.Track{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var item domain.Track
		if err := rows.Scan(&item.ID, &item.Slug, &item.SourceKey, &item.Order, &item.Status, &item.LessonReadAccess, &item.CreatedAt, &item.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

// TrackI18nRepoPG implements TrackI18nRepository.
type TrackI18nRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r TrackI18nRepoPG) Upsert(ctx context.Context, entry domain.TrackI18n) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO track_i18n (track_id, i18n_id, title, description)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4)
ON CONFLICT (track_id, i18n_id) DO UPDATE SET title=EXCLUDED.title, description=EXCLUDED.description`,
		entry.TrackID, entry.I18nID, entry.Title, entry.Description)
	return err
}

func (r TrackI18nRepoPG) ListByTrack(ctx context.Context, trackID string) ([]domain.TrackI18n, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT ti.track_id, ti.i18n_id, i.language, ti.title, ti.description
FROM track_i18n ti
JOIN i18n i ON i.id = ti.i18n_id
WHERE ti.track_id=$1
ORDER BY i.language`, trackID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	result := []domain.TrackI18n{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var entry domain.TrackI18n
		if err := rows.Scan(&entry.TrackID, &entry.I18nID, &entry.Language, &entry.Title, &entry.Description); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, entry)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

func (r TrackI18nRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, trackID string, i18nID int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM track_i18n WHERE track_id=$1 AND i18n_id=$2`, trackID, i18nID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

func (r CourseLevelRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE course_level SET status=$1, updated_at=now() WHERE id=$2`, domain.CatalogStatusNoActive, id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

func (r CourseLevelRepoPG) List(ctx context.Context, filter filters.CourseLevelFilters) ([]domain.CourseLevel, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	args := []any{}
	where := []string{}
	joins := []string{}

	if filter.TrackID != nil {
		joins = append(joins, "JOIN track_level tl ON tl.level_id = l.id")
		args = append(args, *filter.TrackID)
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("tl.track_id = $%d", len(args)))
		where = append(where, "tl.status = 1")
		if filter.ActiveOnly {
			joins = append(joins, "JOIN track t ON t.id = tl.track_id")
			where = append(where, "t.status = 1")
		}
	}
	if filter.Title != nil {
		args = append(args, "%"+*filter.Title+"%")
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM course_level_i18n li WHERE li.level_id = l.id AND li.title ILIKE $%d)", len(args)))
	}
	if filter.ID != nil {
		args = append(args, *filter.ID)
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("l.id = $%d", len(args)))
	}
	if filter.Slug != nil {
		args = append(args, *filter.Slug)
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("l.slug = $%d", len(args)))
	}
	if filter.Status != nil {
		args = append(args, *filter.Status)
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("l.status = $%d", len(args)))
	}
	if filter.ActiveOnly {
		args = append(args, domain.CatalogStatusActive)
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("l.status = $%d", len(args)))
	}

	orderBy := "l.created_at DESC"
	if filter.TrackID != nil {
		orderBy = `tl."order", l.created_at`
	}
	query := `SELECT l.id, l.slug, COALESCE(l.source_key,''), l.status, l.lesson_read_access, l.created_at, l.updated_at FROM course_level l ` + strings.Join(joins, " ")
	if len(where) > 0 {
		query += " WHERE " + strings.Join(where, " AND ")
	}
	query += " ORDER BY " + orderBy

	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	result := []domain.CourseLevel{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var item domain.CourseLevel
		if err := rows.Scan(&item.ID, &item.Slug, &item.SourceKey, &item.Status, &item.LessonReadAccess, &item.CreatedAt, &item.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

func (r CourseGroupRepoPG) List(ctx context.Context, filter filters.CourseGroupFilters) ([]domain.CourseGroup, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	args := []any{}
	where := []string{}
	joins := []string{}

	if filter.LevelID != nil {
		joins = append(joins, "JOIN level_course_group lcg ON lcg.group_id = g.id")
		args = append(args, *filter.LevelID)
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("lcg.level_id = $%d", len(args)))
		where = append(where, "lcg.status = 1")
		if filter.ActiveOnly {
			joins = append(joins, "JOIN course_level l ON l.id = lcg.level_id")
			where = append(where, "l.status = 1")
		}
	}
	if filter.Title != nil {
		args = append(args, "%"+*filter.Title+"%")
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM course_group_i18n gi WHERE gi.group_id = g.id AND gi.title ILIKE $%d)", len(args)))
	}
	if filter.ID != nil {
		args = append(args, *filter.ID)
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("g.id = $%d", len(args)))
	}
	if filter.Slug != nil {
		args = append(args, *filter.Slug)
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("g.slug = $%d", len(args)))
	}
	if filter.Status != nil {
		args = append(args, *filter.Status)
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("g.status = $%d", len(args)))
	}
	if filter.ActiveOnly {
		args = append(args, domain.CatalogStatusActive)
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("g.status = $%d", len(args)))
	}

	orderBy := "g.created_at DESC"
	if filter.LevelID != nil {
		orderBy = `lcg."order", g.created_at`
	}
	query := `SELECT g.id, g.slug, COALESCE(g.source_key,''), g.status, g.lesson_read_access, g.created_at, g.updated_at FROM course_group g ` + strings.Join(joins, " ")
	if len(where) > 0 {
		query += " WHERE " + strings.Join(where, " AND ")
	}
	query += " ORDER BY " + orderBy

	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	result := []domain.CourseGroup{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var item domain.CourseGroup
		if err := rows.Scan(&item.ID, &item.Slug, &item.SourceKey, &item.Status, &item.LessonReadAccess, &item.CreatedAt, &item.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

// CourseGroupI18nRepoPG implements CourseGroupI18nRepository.
type CourseGroupI18nRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r CourseGroupI18nRepoPG) Upsert(ctx context.Context, entry domain.CourseGroupI18n) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO course_group_i18n (group_id, i18n_id, title, description)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4)
ON CONFLICT (group_id, i18n_id) DO UPDATE SET title=EXCLUDED.title, description=EXCLUDED.description`,
		entry.GroupID, entry.I18nID, entry.Title, entry.Description)
	return err
}

func (r CourseGroupI18nRepoPG) ListByGroup(ctx context.Context, groupID string) ([]domain.CourseGroupI18n, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT gi.group_id, gi.i18n_id, i.language, gi.title, gi.description
FROM course_group_i18n gi
JOIN i18n i ON i.id = gi.i18n_id
WHERE gi.group_id=$1
ORDER BY i.language`, groupID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	result := []domain.CourseGroupI18n{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var entry domain.CourseGroupI18n
		if err := rows.Scan(&entry.GroupID, &entry.I18nID, &entry.Language, &entry.Title, &entry.Description); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, entry)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

func (r CourseGroupI18nRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, groupID string, i18nID int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM course_group_i18n WHERE group_id=$1 AND i18n_id=$2`, groupID, i18nID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

// TrackLevelRepoPG implements TrackLevelRepository.
type TrackLevelRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r TrackLevelRepoPG) Add(ctx context.Context, trackID string, levelID string, order int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO track_level (track_id, level_id, "order", status) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,1)
ON CONFLICT (track_id, level_id) DO UPDATE SET "order"=EXCLUDED."order", status=EXCLUDED.status, updated_at=now()`,
		trackID, levelID, order)
	return mapPgError(err)
}

func (r TrackLevelRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, trackID string, levelID string) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM track_level WHERE track_id=$1 AND level_id=$2`, trackID, levelID)
	return err
}

func (r TrackLevelRepoPG) Replace(ctx context.Context, trackID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM track_level WHERE track_id=$1`, trackID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, item := range items {
		if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO track_level (track_id, level_id, "order", status) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,1)`, trackID, item.ChildID, item.Order); err != nil {
			return mapPgError(err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
